per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support multiple relational database vendors through a JDBC-based data access layer.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall avoid database-specific SQL dialects to facilitate porting through configuration changes.
The system shall support deployment on any OS that can run a supported Java runtime.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support deployment in both standard servlet containers and full Java EE/Jakarta EE application servers.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete small, common tasks within five seconds and almost all tasks within eight seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve a four-nines level of availability, excluding catastrophic hardware failure.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support statelessness with externalized session state to facilitate clustering and failover.
The system shall handle approximately 1,000 concurrent requests at launch and scale to handle approximately 2,000 concurrent requests in a subsequent release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate with corporate identity sources for authentication, with no exceptions.
The system shall use structured exception logging with correlation IDs and scrubbed personally identifiable information (PII).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall use encrypted transfer (TLS) and authenticated endpoints for log transmission.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prevent data corruption from malicious inputs through layered defenses, including input validation and parameterized queries.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall expose lightweight health endpoints and metrics for monitoring.
The system shall use structured logs with correlation IDs for traceability and debugging.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be usable without extensive training or complex navigation.
